text: 国务院原则同意《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，营造公平开放的市场环境。有序放宽服务业准入限制，优化新业态新领域市场准入环境。强化平台责任与用户权益保护，推动平台经济反垄断与公平竞争。推动电信、互联网、教育、文化、医疗等领域有序扩大开放，增加高品质商品和服务供给。优化完善跨境电商零售进口政策，扩大境外优质商品进口。高质量办好中国国际进口博览会、中国国际消费品博览会等，集聚全球优质消费资源。
text_en: The State Council agreed in principle to the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption,' creating a fair and open market environment. It will orderly relax access restrictions in the service industry and optimize market access for new business forms and fields. Platform responsibilities and user rights protection will be strengthened, promoting anti-monopoly and fair competition in the platform economy. The orderly expansion of opening up in telecommunications, internet, education, culture, and healthcare will be promoted, increasing the supply of high-quality goods and services. Policies on cross-border e-commerce retail imports will be optimized and improved, expanding imports of high-quality foreign goods. Events like the China International Import Expo and China International Consumer Products Expo will be held to high standards, gathering global quality consumption resources.
